title: Deletion Sensitivity Is a Property of the Model: A Three-Condition Measurement across Seven Open Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.13223v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning models write a reasoning trace at every turn of a multi-turn tool session, and later turns read this history. Across 94k ShareGPT conversations, 73 percent of user interactions span multiple turns. Upstream providers bind each trace to its issuer, so a request forwarded across issuers arrives with its history deleted, and the task cost of this stripping remains unmeasured. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first direct, blind, multi-seed measurement of full reasoning-history deletion in multi-turn tool calling, through three rendering conditions, seven open-weight reasoning models, three seeds, 794 tasks, and the official checker. The same deletion spans -4.4 to +51.3 points with both ends excluding zero, and for the one model re-dosed from 0 to 100 percent deletion, the reading varies by at most 1.5 points. Deletion sensitivity is a model-level property. The reading follows the model itself and stays cons

translated_title: 删除敏感性是模型的一种属性：对七个开放推理模型的三条件测量
translated_abstract: 推理模型在多轮工具会话的每一轮都会写下一条推理轨迹，而后续轮次会读取这段历史。在94k条ShareGPT对话中，73%的用户交互跨越多轮。上游提供商将每条推理轨迹绑定到其发出者，因此跨发出者转发的请求到达时其历史已被删除，而这种剥离操作带来的任务成本此前从未被测量。据我们所知，本文首次对多轮工具调用中完整推理历史删除进行了直接、盲测、多种子的测量，涵盖三种渲染条件、七个开放权重推理模型、三个随机种子、794个任务以及官方检查器。相同的删除操作导致的性能变化跨度为-4.4到+51.3分，且两端均不包含零；对于唯一一个从0%到100%删除比例重新测试的模型，其读数变化最多仅1.5分。删除敏感性是模型层面的属性。该读数跟随模型本身并保持稳定（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文首次通过三种渲染条件、七个开放权重推理模型、三个种子和794个任务的盲测实验，系统测量了多轮工具调用中删除完整推理历史对任务性能的影响，发现相同删除操作导致的性能变化跨度达-4.4到+51.3分，且这种删除敏感性是模型层面的固有属性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first direct, blind, multi-seed measurement of full reasoning-history deletion in multi-turn tool calling across seven open-weight reasoning models, showing that identical deletion causes performance shifts spanning -4.4 to +51.3 points and that deletion sensitivity is an inherent model-level property.
